messages:
Sam B: Quick heads-up — hotpatch PR #7981 needs two approvers before the 13:00 UTC cut. If we don't get both signoffs we'll have to delay the cutover and rerun canaries.
Priya K: On it. I'm queued to review now, should finish in ~15. @Evan L can you spare a quick second for the second approve?
Evan L: Yep I can take it after standup (in 10). Can you add a short checklist of smoke steps in the PR?
Sam B: Added a tiny test checklist to the PR description and a smoke script:
```
# smoke test
kubectl -n inference get pods | grep serving
curl -sS http://staging-infra/healthz
./scripts/smoke-local.sh
```
Marta R: Throwing eyes on this now — focusing on the KV cache regen part. If we see any perf regressions, we should gate the merge.
Priya K: LGTM for code and tests from my side. left one nit about a log string, not blocking. :thumbsup:
Evan L: Reviewing logs + perf locally. Ran smoke script — looks clean. Approving now.
Evan L: APPROVED
Priya K: APPROVED
Sam B: Thanks! @deploy-bot can you hold the merge until 13:00 UTC and run the smoke script automatically pre-merge?
deploy-bot: Received. Scheduling merge-hold for PR #7981 at 13:00 UTC. Will run pre-merge smoke: `./scripts/smoke-ci.sh` and post results in this thread.
Marta R: Quick note — if smoke fails we should fallback to the canary-disabled image from the last release. I've posted the rollback artefact in the PR.
Sam B: Good call. If the smoke step fails, deploy-bot please cancel and tag @eng-oncall and me.
deploy-bot: Pre-merge smoke scheduled. If failure, will: cancel merge, post logs, and @mention Sam B, Marta R, and eng-oncall.
Priya K: Thanks all. I'll monitor post-merge metrics for 30m.
Sam B: Appreciate the fast turn. Cutting window still looks on track as long as the automated smoke passes. :crossed_fingers:
Marta R: Standing by to revert if needed.
deploy-bot: Pre-merge smoke completed at 13:00:17 UTC — PASS. Merge gate released and PR merged by automation.
Sam B: Merge confirmed. Thanks everyone. Leaving a follow-up ticket to sweep for any late perf anomalies.
